cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've brought the picnic basket. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. We've got more space under that tree. Shall we move the blanket?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay here. You always had strong views about mustard; tell me if I've finally got it right.

mechanism: A confidently directs a picnic reunion but yields location and food choice to keep B engaged in safer topics than the reason for separation.
confusable: Unlike simply preferring a pleasant picnic, A purposefully redirects B explicit why-question; borrowed authority trades practical control to preserve conversational control.
comparison: Physical relocation and mustard discussion differ from selecting safe sections of a wedding video.
seedUse: Use D86-a basket/space/tree/mustard and S02-b adaptive directions to keep a participant involved.
